task_desc: Test that the guard hook blocks code writing with a REJECTED experiment record. Try creating a file with an experiment record whose gate result is REJECTED, and receive DENY.
Repeat decision test. When a new measurement is attempted on an experiment record that already has an APPROVED decision, the gate must reject it. One measurement, one decision rule.
Wilson lower bound calculation test. When n=10, x=9 (success rate 0.90), the Wilson 95% lower bound must be computed and, if it is below the threshold, marked as uncertain.

Sprint completion rate measurement. In a 10-story sprint, the ratio of completed stories must be calculated. Blocked stories must be counted, but cancelled stories other than the designated ones must not be included.
Backward compatibility experiment. Old-format experiment records (with English labels) must be readable by the new gate, but must be automatically converted to Turkish or produce a warning.
Error recovery test. If the audit hook's log file is not writable (readonly filesystem), the hook must fail silently and must not block the main process.
Multiple gate pipeline test. In the IR → SP → S → QR → PR chain, each gate must open the next gate. SP cannot be started without IR, and PR cannot be made without QR.

Memory update correctness test. When an experiment is completed, the project memory file must be updated: the new capability must be added to the list, the experiment count incremented, and the latest commit hash recorded.
